threat_event: Ransomware encrypts clinic endpoints, file services, and cloud workloads, halting clinics, the ASC, and the imaging center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat networks at Clinics 4-8; privileged access management only in the cloud; untested recovery of interface engine, PACS, and data warehouse
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-05; SYS-06; BP-01 to BP-10
likelihood_basis: EV-012 (flat networks at Clinics 4-8); EV-006 (privileged access broker for cloud only); EV-024 (no restore tests); EV-033 (7.8% phishing click rate)
sp800_53_controls: CP-9; CP-10; CP-4; AC-6; SC-7; SI-4
existing_controls: MFA for all users; EDR on all managed endpoints with 24x7 MSSP; immutable backups in a separate account; EHR vendor DR tested annually
treatment_plan: Segment Clinics 4-8; extend privileged access management to on-premises and SaaS admins; quarterly restore tests for interface engine, PACS, and data warehouse; ransomware tabletop

threat_event: Exfiltration of PHI for extortion before or during a ransomware attack (double extortion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No egress anomaly detection or data loss prevention on the data warehouse and file services; PACS and interface engine not logging to the SIEM
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 data warehouse and file services; SYS-03
likelihood_basis: EV-019 (PACS and interface engine not in the SIEM); EV-017 (14 users with warehouse extract rights)
existing_controls: EDR; SIEM on IdP, EHR, cloud, firewall, and EDR logs; MFA
treatment_plan: Send PACS, interface engine, and data warehouse logs to the SIEM; egress alerting on large transfers; restrict warehouse extracts to named analysts
exposure_estimate_usd: $3M-$8M (up to 110,000 patients notified; counsel, forensics, credit monitoring, regulatory)

threat_event: Malware spreads from a workstation to networked medical devices at an unsegmented clinic
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Medical devices share the workstation VLAN at Clinics 4-8
likelihood_basis: EV-012 (devices on the workstation VLAN at Clinics 4-8); EV-010 (no EDR on devices)
existing_controls: EDR on workstations (not on devices); site firewalls
treatment_plan: Device VLANs and access rules at Clinics 4-8, starting with the two largest clinics

threat_event: Attacker exploits a legacy Windows modality console at the ASC or imaging center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 vendor-locked legacy Windows consoles (ASC C-arm, imaging center MRI) that cannot run EDR
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07 (ASC C-arm; imaging MRI); BP-04; BP-07
likelihood_basis: EV-014 (2 legacy consoles); EV-010 (no EDR agent on the consoles)
existing_controls: Consoles on segmented device VLANs at the ASC and imaging center
treatment_plan: Restrict each console to vendor-required flows only; application allowlisting; budget replacement in 2027 capital plan

threat_event: Exploitation of an unknown vulnerable networked device that is not in the inventory
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Medical device inventory about 60% complete; devices excluded from vulnerability scanning
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (about 240 of about 400 devices listed); EV-015 (devices outside scan scope)
existing_controls: Partial inventory from purchasing records
treatment_plan: Passive network discovery at all 10 sites; complete inventory with owner, OS, and support status; quarterly reconciliation

threat_event: Loss of the ASC infusion pump network or pump server during a cyber event forces manual pump programming
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No cyber-specific pump downtime procedure; pump server not in backup scope
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07 (ASC pumps and pump server); BP-05
likelihood_basis: EV-025 (no pump downtime procedure); EV-018 (pump server outside backup scope)
existing_controls: Pumps run on last loaded library; ASC device VLAN
treatment_plan: Pump downtime procedure with independent double-check; back up pump server configuration and library; include in ASC exercise

threat_event: Workforce member views patient records without a job need and it is not detected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EHR audit review covers only VIP patients; no broad inappropriate-access analytics
likelihood_basis: EV-021 (VIP-only access review); EV-007 (role catalog)
existing_controls: VIP flag review; role-based access; sanctions policy
treatment_plan: Procure EHR access analytics (family, co-worker, neighbor, and high-volume rules); monthly Privacy Officer review

threat_event: Former or transferred user keeps access because reviews are annual
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Access reviews annual (last January 2026); 118 terminations and 64 transfers in 12 months
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (annual review, January 2026); EV-003 (118 terminations, 64 transfers); EV-004 (roles change by ticket on transfer)
existing_controls: HR termination feed to the identity provider; MFA
treatment_plan: Quarterly access reviews for EHR, IdP, cloud, and PACS; transfer workflow removes old roles

threat_event: Privileged account on a SaaS admin console or the on-premises directory is taken over and used to disable defenses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Privileged access management covers only the cloud accounts; standing admin rights elsewhere
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 admin; SYS-02 admin; on-premises directory; SYS-06
likelihood_basis: EV-006 (standing admin rights outside the cloud); EV-002 (push and code MFA)
existing_controls: MFA on all accounts; EDR
treatment_plan: Extend privileged access management to directory, IdP, EHR, and PACS admins; phishing-resistant MFA for admins; remove standing domain admin

threat_event: PHI is disclosed by one of 30 vendors that have no BAA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 30 of 140 PHI vendors have no BAA on file
likelihood_basis: EV-036 (30 PHI vendors without a BAA)
existing_controls: BAA template; 110 BAAs on file
treatment_plan: Execute BAAs with the 30 vendors or stop the PHI flow; contract gate in purchasing

threat_event: A business associate's security failure exposes company PHI and is not detected until the vendor reports it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor reviews happen only at onboarding; no tiering or reassessment
likelihood_basis: EV-037 (no reassessment records)
existing_controls: Onboarding questionnaire
treatment_plan: Tiered vendor risk program with annual SOC 2 review for Tier 1 vendors (P09); BAA notice terms of 5 business days

threat_event: Multi-week clearinghouse outage stops claims, eligibility, and remittance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single clearinghouse for all payers; no tested alternate connection
likelihood_basis: EV-042 (single clearinghouse, about $1.9 million a week); EV-054 (past clearinghouse delays)
existing_controls: Payer portals for manual claims; revolving credit line
treatment_plan: Contract a secondary clearinghouse with tested connectivity; vendor outage runbook (P08); cash-flow playbook with the CFO
exposure_estimate_usd: $1.9M per week of delayed cash; $60K-$300K of losses

threat_event: Extended EHR vendor outage (for example ransomware at the vendor) exceeds clinical MTDs
threat_source: EHR vendor infrastructure failure or cyber incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor RTO 12 h and RPO 1 h versus BIA RTO 2-4 h; single SaaS dependency
likelihood_basis: EV-038 (vendor RTO 12 h, RPO 1 h); EV-053 (owners' tolerances)
existing_controls: Downtime report workstations with hourly extracts; paper forms; vendor DR tested annually
treatment_plan: Negotiate recovery terms; 15-minute ASC extract; downtime drills at every site

threat_event: Interface engine cannot be restored within its 8-hour RTO after a failure or attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Interface engine recovery never tested; runbook incomplete
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 interface engine; BP-08; BP-09; BP-10
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no rebuild procedure or test); EV-018 (no restore jobs)
existing_controls: Daily immutable backups
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore test to an isolated network; documented rebuild procedure

threat_event: PACS cannot be restored within its 6-hour RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PACS recovery never tested; vendor-managed in the company's cloud account
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no rebuild procedure or test); EV-018 (no restore jobs)
existing_controls: Daily immutable backups; modality local storage (about 3 days)
treatment_plan: Joint restore test with the PACS vendor; written RTO in the vendor agreement

threat_event: Data warehouse restore fails or takes longer than its 120-hour RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Data warehouse recovery never tested
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no restore test); EV-018 (no restore jobs)
existing_controls: Daily immutable backups; can rebuild from the EHR
treatment_plan: Annual restore test; document rebuild from the EHR

threat_event: A cyber event during ASC operations (EHR loss or pump network loss) is handled without cyber-specific emergency procedures
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ASC emergency preparedness plan does not address cyber events (EV-026)
likelihood_basis: EV-026 (no cyber hazard in the ASC plan); EV-057 (ASC Administrator interview)
existing_controls: General ASC emergency plan (fire, hurricane, utility loss)
treatment_plan: Add cyber hazards to the ASC all-hazards risk assessment and plan; cyber downtime tabletop at the ASC; staff training
exposure_estimate_usd: $100K-$500K plus survey deficiency and patient safety exposure

threat_event: OCR investigation after a breach finds long-standing gaps in audit review, BAAs, and contingency testing
likelihood_basis: EV-021 (VIP-only review); EV-036 (30 vendors without a BAA); EV-024 (no recovery tests)
existing_controls: Annual risk analysis; policies adopted 2023; POA&M
treatment_plan: Close Required-specification gaps on the P03 roadmap; quarterly POA&M reporting to the audit committee

threat_event: AI scribe records visits without documented all-party consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No standard consent script or documentation field; tool adopted without privacy review (EV-050)
likelihood_basis: EV-050 (scribe adopted without review); EV-054 (consent asked verbally by some providers)
existing_controls: Some providers ask verbally
treatment_plan: Written notice at check-in, verbal consent script, EHR consent field, audit of 30 notes per month

threat_event: AI vendors use PHI for model training or other secondary purposes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI tools adopted by departments without security or privacy review; scribe BAA permits de-identified data use; chatbot vendor has no BAA
likelihood_basis: EV-036 (scribe BAA permits de-identified use; no chatbot BAA); EV-037 (no AI review records)
existing_controls: Scribe vendor standard BAA
treatment_plan: Amend AI vendor BAAs (no training, deletion terms); execute or replace chatbot vendor

threat_event: EHR decision-support alerts or imaging triage produce discriminatory outcomes by age, sex, race, or disability
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No inventory of input variables for patient care decision support tools (45 CFR 92.210(b))
likelihood_basis: EV-050 (212 alert rules; triage module)
existing_controls: FDA clearance for AI-003; EHR vendor content
treatment_plan: Inventory input variables for 212 alert rules and AI-003; mitigate identified rules; annual review by the CMO

threat_event: AI imaging triage misses a critical finding and delays a read
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Triage is a prioritization aid; radiologists still read every study
likelihood_basis: EV-050 (triage module in PACS since 2025)
existing_controls: FDA clearance; every study is read by a radiologist; critical results policy
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low; monitor quarterly discordance reports

threat_event: Website chatbot collects PHI without a BAA or gives unsafe medical advice
threat_source: Service provider or AI model error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Chatbot adopted without review; no BAA; free-text field allows symptoms
likelihood_basis: EV-036 (no chatbot BAA); EV-050 (chatbot in use since 2026-04)
existing_controls: Chatbot scripted for scheduling
treatment_plan: Execute BAA or replace vendor; disable free-text symptom entry; add disclaimer and nurse-line handoff

threat_event: Prior-authorization automation submits inaccurate clinical information to payers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No sampling of automated submissions; tool adopted without review
likelihood_basis: EV-054 (about 70% submitted without review); EV-050 (adopted without review)
existing_controls: Staff review exceptions flagged by the tool
treatment_plan: Monthly sample of 50 submissions; human approval for ASC cases

threat_event: Staff paste PHI into unapproved public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list; no web filtering of AI sites
likelihood_basis: EV-050 (staff report public AI use; no approved-tools list or web filter category)
existing_controls: Annual training
treatment_plan: Approved AI tools list; web category controls; enterprise AI tool under BAA

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a vendor payment or payroll deposit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment change verification is informal
likelihood_basis: EV-054 (payment changes confirmed by email reply); EV-033 (7.8% click rate)
existing_controls: MFA; phishing simulations
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for bank changes; finance-specific phishing training

threat_event: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing bypasses MFA and exposes mailbox PHI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push and code MFA are phishable; 7.8% click rate
likelihood_basis: EV-002 (push and code MFA); EV-033 (7.8% click rate)
existing_controls: Conditional access; MFA; MSSP IdP alerting
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for admins and CBO; token-theft detections

threat_event: Known-exploited vulnerability in an internet-facing SD-WAN or VPN appliance is exploited before the next scan cycle
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vulnerability scanning is quarterly; no known-exploited vulnerability watch process
likelihood_basis: EV-015 (quarterly scans); EV-013 (internet-facing edge appliances)
existing_controls: Quarterly scans; vendor-managed SD-WAN
treatment_plan: Monthly authenticated scans; weekly known-exploited vulnerability review; 14-day patch target for edge devices

threat_event: Cloud storage or data warehouse is exposed to the internet by misconfiguration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Configuration standards thin (EV-023)
likelihood_basis: EV-017 (guardrails block public storage); EV-023 (no configuration standard)
existing_controls: Organization guardrails block public storage; cloud posture alerts to the SIEM
treatment_plan: Documented cloud configuration standard; monthly posture review

threat_event: Backups in the backup account are deleted or encrypted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup account uses separate credentials and write-once retention
likelihood_basis: EV-018 (separate account; write-once retention)
existing_controls: Separate account; 35-day write-once retention; separate admin credentials
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Moderate within appetite; restore tests (R-014 to R-016) will confirm

threat_event: CBO employee exports patient financial and insurance data for identity theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad report and export rights in the practice management module
likelihood_basis: EV-007 (export rights in CBO roles); EV-003 (about 120 CBO staff)
existing_controls: Role-based access
treatment_plan: Restrict export rights to named roles; alert on large exports

threat_event: Laptop or tablet with cached PHI is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 870 mobile and fixed endpoints; tablets used at check-in
likelihood_basis: EV-009 (870 endpoints; encryption and remote wipe)
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption and remote wipe on laptops and tablets (device management)
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low; encrypted devices are not unsecured PHI

threat_event: Hurricane closes several clinics, the CBO, or the ASC for days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida exposure; single ISP at clinics
likelihood_basis: EV-054 (past hurricane closures); EV-012 (single ISP at clinics); EV-026 (hurricane plan)
existing_controls: Cloud-hosted systems; ASC all-hazards plan; hurricane season checklist
treatment_plan: Cellular failover kits; remote work plan for the CBO; annual hurricane exercise

threat_event: Single-ISP outage at a clinic stops clinical work for a day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Clinics have one ISP; SD-WAN has no cellular path
likelihood_basis: EV-012 (single ISP; no cellular path); EV-054 (past ISP outages)
existing_controls: SD-WAN monitoring
treatment_plan: Cellular backup on SD-WAN at each clinic

threat_event: Identity provider outage blocks access to all SSO applications
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All applications depend on SSO; break-glass accounts not tested
likelihood_basis: EV-001 (all applications through SSO); EV-055 (break-glass not tested)
existing_controls: Vendor SLA; SOC 2 report
treatment_plan: Break-glass accounts per critical system, stored offline and tested quarterly

threat_event: MSSP misses or delays an attack because key systems do not send logs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PACS, interface engine, and medical devices not in the SIEM; use cases not reviewed
likelihood_basis: EV-019 (sources not connected); EV-020 (use cases unchanged since 2024)
existing_controls: 24x7 MSSP; 30-minute high-severity call
treatment_plan: Onboard PACS, interface engine, and device monitoring logs; quarterly MSSP service review with detection tests

threat_event: Compromise of the MSSP's or EHR vendor's remote access reaches company systems (supply chain)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSSP agents and vendor tools run with high privilege; reviews only at onboarding
likelihood_basis: EV-037 (SOC 2 reports at onboarding only); EV-010 (MSSP agents on all endpoints)
existing_controls: MFA on vendor access; SOC 2 reports received at onboarding
treatment_plan: Annual SOC 2 review with CUEC mapping (P09); vendor access through the privileged access broker

threat_event: PACS vendor remote support session is used to access PHI or pivot into the cloud account
threat_source: Service provider or attacker using vendor credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-managed PACS with a standing admin role; sessions not recorded
likelihood_basis: EV-013 (PACS vendor standing remote access); EV-052 (vendor support role)
existing_controls: MFA on vendor role
treatment_plan: Just-in-time vendor access with approval and session recording

threat_event: PHI sent to the wrong recipient by fax, email, or portal message
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High message volume; no outbound verification
likelihood_basis: EV-049 (message volume); EV-054 (misdirected messages reported)
existing_controls: Training; fax cover sheets
treatment_plan: Address verification prompts; quarterly reminders

threat_event: Configuration drift weakens servers and network devices because standards are thin
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No documented configuration baselines for servers, network devices, and medical device consoles (EV-023)
likelihood_basis: EV-023 (no configuration standard); EV-016 (baselines for workstations and cloud images only)
existing_controls: Vendor defaults; change tickets
treatment_plan: Configuration standard (P06 standards index) with benchmark-based baselines and drift reporting

threat_event: Investigation cannot scope a breach because logs are missing or expired
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Logging standard thin; PACS, interface engine, and file services not centrally logged
likelihood_basis: EV-019 (sources not connected; 1-year retention); EV-022 (interface logs local)
existing_controls: SIEM retains 1 year for connected sources
treatment_plan: Logging standard with event types and 6-year retention for EHR audit data; onboard missing sources
exposure_estimate_usd: Larger notification population if scope cannot be limited

threat_event: Breach notification deadline is missed (Florida 30 days or HIPAA 60 days)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Runbook not integrated with legal and crisis management before this project
likelihood_basis: EV-030 (2023 plan); EV-056 (breach procedure interview)
existing_controls: Compliance and Privacy Officer owns breach decisions
treatment_plan: Notification matrix and decision log in P08; annual tabletop with counsel

threat_event: Denial of service against the website and patient portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-hosted portal and website
likelihood_basis: EV-038 (vendor-hosted portal); EV-039 (provider DDoS protection)
existing_controls: Vendor DDoS protection; CDN for website
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low

threat_event: Unauthorized entry to a clinic network closet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Keyed locks at some clinic closets; no key log
likelihood_basis: EV-045 (keyed Clinic 5 closet; no key log); EV-046 (Clinics 4-8 closets keyed)
existing_controls: Alarm systems after hours
treatment_plan: Badge readers on network closets at Clinics 4-8

threat_event: SOC 2 Type 2 report is not ready when the joint venture starts, delaying or losing the joint venture
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Controls not yet operating for a full observation period; gaps in CC6, CC7, CC9, and A1
likelihood_basis: EV-044 (partner request for SOC 2 Type 2); EV-028 (internal IT audit)
existing_controls: Annual internal IT audit
treatment_plan: Readiness remediation (P09); observation period 2027-04-01 to 2027-09-30
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$5M a year of joint venture revenue at risk

threat_event: PHI remains on a leased modality or copier drive returned to the lessor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No sanitization certificates required from modality and copier lessors
likelihood_basis: EV-040 (no sanitization clause in leases); EV-047 (lease return checklist)
existing_controls: Lease return checklist
treatment_plan: Contract clause and certificate of sanitization for every returned device

threat_event: Interface mapping error files a result or report in the wrong patient's chart
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Interface change testing informal
likelihood_basis: EV-022 (interface changes reviewed by one analyst)
existing_controls: Interface analyst review
treatment_plan: Formal interface change testing with a second reviewer

threat_event: A newly acquired practice connects to the network with unknown security weaknesses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security due diligence or integration standard for acquisitions
likelihood_basis: EV-023 (no acquisition integration standard)
existing_controls: IT integration checklist
treatment_plan: Security due diligence and 90-day integration standard before network connection

threat_event: Patient portal accounts are taken over through credential stuffing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal MFA optional for patients
likelihood_basis: EV-038 (portal MFA optional)
existing_controls: Vendor rate limiting and lockout
treatment_plan: Offer and promote portal MFA; vendor anomaly alerts

threat_event: Attacker uses PACS vendor service accounts with domain administrator rights and non-expiring passwords
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 vendor service accounts with domain administrator rights and non-expiring passwords (found in P07 testing)
likelihood_basis: EV-AC-6 (vendor domain administrator accounts found in P07 testing); EV-IA-5 (non-expiring passwords)
existing_controls: None specific
treatment_plan: Remove domain administrator rights; managed service accounts with rotated credentials; vault the remaining secrets
